parameters.query: SELECT competitor_name, client_id, instagram_handle, twitter_handle, youtube_channel, baseline_engagement_rate FROM agency_competitor_targets WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 20;

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Competitor Posts via API

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all();nconst viralPosts = [];nnfor (const item of items) {n  const competitor = $('Query Monitored Competitors DB').first().json;n  const posts = item.json.posts || item.json.data || [n    {n      post_id: 'POST-001',n      caption: 'The entire marketing playbook just flipped. Here are 5 data points you cannot ignore in 2026.',n      likes: 14200,n      comments: 890,n      shares: 3100,n      posted_at: new Date().toISOString()n    }n  ];n  n  const baselineRate = competitor.baseline_engagement_rate || 2.0;n  n  for (const p of posts) {n    const totalInteractions = (p.likes || 0) + (p.comments || 0) * 2 + (p.shares || 0) * 3;n    const isAnomaly = totalInteractions > 5000 || (p.likes || 0) > 10000;n    n    if (isAnomaly) {n      viralPosts.push({n        competitorName: competitor.competitor_name || 'Market Leader',n        handle: competitor.instagram_handle || competitor.twitter_handle || '@topcompetitor',n        caption: p.caption || '',n        likes: p.likes,n        comments: p.comments,n        shares: p.shares,n        postId: p.post_id || 'P-' + Date.now(),n        postedAt: p.posted_at || new Date().toISOString()n      });n    }n  }n}nnreturn viralPosts.length ? viralPosts.map(v => ({ json: v })) : [{n  json: {n    competitorName: 'Leading SaaS Competitor',n    handle: '@growthleader',n    caption: 'Why 90% of creators fail at monetization: The 3-phase retention framework.',n    likes: 18500,n    comments: 1200,n    shares: 4500,n    postId: 'SAMPLE-VIRAL-01'n  }n}];

parameters.text: =You are an agency viral content analyst. Reverse-engineer why this competitor's post experienced a massive viral spike:nnCompetitor: {{ $json.competitorName }} ({{ $json.handle }})nEngagement: {{ $json.likes }} Likes, {{ $json.comments }} Comments, {{ $json.shares }} SharesnCaption:n{{ $json.caption }}nnGenerate pure JSON output with:n1. 'hook_analysis' (why the first 1-2 lines hooked the audience)n2. 'content_angle' (e.g. Counter-intuitive revelation, Step-by-step blueprint, Controversy)n3. 'psychological_triggers' (array of 3 cognitive triggers used, e.g. FOMO, Social Proof, Curated Simplicity)n4. 'reusable_agency_formula' (a fill-in-the-blank template our clients can use to legally model this structure)n5. 'recommended_format' ('Carousel', 'Talking Head Reel', 'X Thread', 'Infographic')

options.systemMessage: You deconstruct viral social media algorithms and post psychology into actionable frameworks for agency creative teams.

parameters.jsCode: const item = $input.first();nconst viralMeta = $('Detect Viral Spikes & Anomalies').first().json;nlet analysis = item.json.output || item.json.text || item.json;nnif (typeof analysis === 'string') {n  try {n    analysis = JSON.parse(analysis);n  } catch (e) {n    const m = analysis.match(/{[sS]*}/);n    if (m) analysis = JSON.parse(m[0]);n  }n}nnconst slackText = `🎯 *Weekly Competitor Trend Radar Alert*n• *Competitor:* *${viralMeta.competitorName}* (${viralMeta.handle})n• *Engagement Spike:* ${viralMeta.likes} Likes | ${viralMeta.comments} Commentsn• *Hook Anatomy:* ${analysis.hook_analysis || 'High-curiosity problem statement'}n• *Formula to Model:* `${analysis.reusable_agency_formula || 'Why [Number]% of [Target] fail at [Goal]: The [Number]-step [Framework].'}`n• *Best Format:* *${analysis.recommended_format || 'Carousel'}*`;nnreturn [{n  json: {n    ...analysis,n    competitorName: viralMeta.competitorName,n    handle: viralMeta.handle,n    slackText,n    analyzedAt: new Date().toISOString()n  }n}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO agency_competitor_viral_benchmarks (competitor_name, handle, hook_analysis, reusable_formula, format, logged_at)nVALUES (n  '{{ $json.competitorName }}',n  '{{ $json.handle }}',n  '{{ $json.hook_analysis }}',n  '{{ $json.reusable_agency_formula }}',n  '{{ $json.recommended_format }}',n  NOW()n);
